proposals.evidence: DEDR 4889 gives Tamil/Malayalam mukam, Kannada moga/mōṟe, Tulu mōrè, and Gondi mokom/mukam face. The selected simple face stems match this family; mūñci/mond- responses belong to a separate family and are not merged. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR474 and3918 explicitly document Tamil/Malayalam iru-patu/iru-vatu twenty, Kannada irpattu/ippattu, Kodagu iru-vadï and Kota irvād. Propose ordered two × ten components for the selected southern survey forms, preserving assimilated pp/bb, initial-glide variants and final vowels. Minority-lect forms are comparative extensions; neighbouring Gondi/Gadaba/Konda contact-sensitive numeral sets are excluded.

proposals.evidence: Propose ordered ten + six. DEDR3918 documents the patiṉ-/padn-/pon- combining forms of ten in these teens, and DEDR2485 gives āṟu/ār six and explicitly Toda pāṟ sixteen. The southern census variants retain contraction, p/h alternation and vowel notation; uncertain census lect labels remain source qualifications, not corrections.

proposals.evidence: Propose ordered four × ten. DEDR3655 and3918 explicitly give Tamil nāṟpatu/nāppatu, Malayalam nālpatu, Kannada nālvattu and Kota nālvat forty. Survey forms are comparative variants of these formations, preserving assimilation, reduced vowels and final vowels. No independent one-stem etymology is substituted for the two numeral components.
